be1d41fe-7eb4-45af-9d04-ac889497efe9/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> follows the disciples of Yuanshan through a deep and narrow corridor.<NL>Moss dots the stone walls, candle flames flicker like tiny beans, and at the end lies a Stone Cell bereft of any daylight.<NL><NL>Sitting cross-legged at its center, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> closes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes and steadies <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> spirit.<NL>Time flows by unnoticed before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> body suddenly feels light and <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> mind wavers.<NL>When <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> opens <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> eyes in alarm, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderSubject/> finds <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderObject/>self drifting in midair—as though <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> very soul has separated from <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderPossessive/> body...
be1d41fe-7eb4-45af-9d04-ac889497efe9/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>跟随元山弟子穿过幽深甬道，<NL>但见石壁苔痕斑驳，烛火摇曳如豆，行至尽处，便见一间不见天光的石牢，<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>坐入石牢之间，闭目凝神，<NL>不知过了多久，忽觉周身一轻，心神摇荡，急忙睁眼看时，<NL>只见自己双足离地，飘然凌空而行，竟而好似神魂脱离了躯体一般……

56260fcd-e47e-4f8b-a3a5-cd3e08d3ff86/Eve.en: Spirit drifting freely, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> glides for what feels like an eternity<NL>until reaching the chamber deep within the stone cell—the place where the Three Demons are sealed.<NL>Inside the cavern, three massive stone pillars burst from the ground and pierce the ceiling.<NL>Each pillar coils with several thick, black iron chains carved with talismanic runes;<NL>around them shimmer three ancient swords and treasured blades, their glow rippling like light through a vast heavenly net that binds the demons below...<NL><NL><NL>"Taiwu brat... how dare you treat us like prisoners, bound in chains?!"<NL>"Taiwu... it's been so long. Ahh, that scent of yours—it tempts terribly..."<NL>"You must come here for a reason... Tell us, Successor of Taiwu, what brings you here?"
56260fcd-e47e-4f8b-a3a5-cd3e08d3ff86/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>任由神魂飘荡前行，<NL>不知过了多久，终于行至石牢深处，镇压三魔的洞窟之前。<NL>但见洞窟之内之中三根粗大石柱破地而出，直插洞顶，每根石柱之上，<NL>皆缠有数条碗口粗细、刻满符文的乌黑铁链，更有三柄古剑宝刀，<NL>光华流转，自上而下，如天网一般笼罩着三魔……<NL><NL><NL>“太吾小儿……竟敢将吾等视同阶下之囚，锁困于此？！”<NL>“太吾……许久不来，吾想念你得紧呐……便是这香味，实在诱人……”<NL>“无事不登三宝殿……太吾传人今日来此，不知所为何事？”

9a0e000a-8f45-4e1f-aa5b-b3f8edc656de/Eve.en: "You must have banished the embodiment for a reason, Successor of Taiwu...<NL><NL>This time, we will grant you our full strength to lay the enemy to rest.<NL>Yet we are bound here, we can only employ the Art of One Becoming Myriad,<NL>condensing one of our spirits into an embodiment to aid you in battle..."<NL><NL>Humanly Demon opens the three bloody eyes in its abdomen, seemingly glance toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>:<NL>"Tell us, which of our embodiments do you require?"
9a0e000a-8f45-4e1f-aa5b-b3f8edc656de/Eve.cn: “太吾传人驱逐化身，想来自有考量……<NL><NL>此番吾等亦当倾力相助，为太吾传人摧坚陷敌，<NL>只是吾等困锁于此，身不得脱，唯有施展‘以一化万’之术，<NL>将吾等一念，凝作化身，代吾等为太吾传人助阵……”<NL><NL>三魔·人睁开腹中三只血眼，似是向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>看来：<NL>“不知太吾传人，需要吾等谁之化身？”

27e20bb5-8dc0-4fef-9073-a08f6bf1212e/Eve.en: "Hmph! Taiwu brat, so that's all you've got!<NL>In the end, you still depend on our might to prevail..."<NL><NL>Three Demons - Heaven lets out a cold snort, lifting one arm skyward.<NL>A wisp of dark aura oozed from its mouth and tongue, twisting in the air before merging into the Bead of Desire.<NL>In an instant, the bead radiates dark aura, and within it flickers the shadow of the Heavenly Demon Embodiment...
27e20bb5-8dc0-4fef-9073-a08f6bf1212e/Eve.cn: “哼！太吾小儿，也不过如此！<NL>到头来，还不是需仰仗吾等神力，方能成事……”<NL><NL>三魔·天一声冷哼，单臂擎天，<NL>一缕黑气自其口舌溢出，那缕黑气于空中略一扭曲挣扎，终而没入化念珠内，<NL>霎时间，珠身乌芒四溢，其中更隐现三魔·天化身之影……

b87b1e95-9563-41d3-9fce-b5b29aa3338f/Eve.en: "Taiwu... since you have come seeking our aid, how could I possibly refuse?"<NL><NL>Earth smiles gently and raises both arms.<NL>A wisp of dark aura seeps from the thousand hands upon its abdomen, twisting in the air before merging into the Bead of Desire.<NL>In an instant, the bead radiates dark aura, and within it flickers the shadow of the Earthly Demon Embodiment...
b87b1e95-9563-41d3-9fce-b5b29aa3338f/Eve.cn: “太吾……既有所求，吾怎能不应……”<NL><NL>三魔·地柔柔一笑，张开双臂，<NL>一缕黑气自其腹中千手溢出，那缕黑气于空中略一扭曲挣扎，终而没入化念珠内，<NL>霎时间，珠身乌芒四溢，其中更隐现三魔·地化身之影……
b87b1e95-9563-41d3-9fce-b5b29aa3338f/Eve.ru: "Тайу... Раз уж ты пришел за нашей помощью, как я могу отказать?"<NL><NL>Земля мягко улыбается и поднимает обе руки.<NL>Струйка темной ауры просачивается из тысячи рук на его животе, извиваясь в воздухе, прежде чем слиться в Бусинку Желания.<NL>В одно мгновение бусина излучает темную ауру, и внутри нее мерцает тень земного Воплощения Демона...

0dab6b0b-fed9-4aac-9b16-c05201b94acc/Eve.en: "When you banish Xiangshu and reclaim the mortal realm,<NL>remember well the aid we have given you..."<NL><NL>The Three Demons - Human inclines its head slightly, the bloodlight in its eyes swirling.<NL>A thread of dark aura oozes from those blood-filled eyes, writhing in the air before fusing into the Bead of Desire.<NL>In an instant, the bead radiates dark aura, and within it flickers the shadow of the Humanly Demon Embodiment...
0dab6b0b-fed9-4aac-9b16-c05201b94acc/Eve.cn: “来日太吾传人驱逐相枢，重掌人间，<NL>可要记得吾等相助之情……”<NL><NL>三魔·人微微颔首，血目光芒流转，<NL>一缕黑气自其血目溢出，那缕黑气于空中略一扭曲挣扎，终而没入化念珠内，<NL>霎时间，珠身乌芒四溢，其中更隐现三魔·人化身之影……

f39c521b-d100-495e-bbb8-cef1c82e8d83/Eve.en: "Taiwu receives Heaven's aid, slaying demons and purging evil, always victorious!"<NL><NL>The Trinity - Heaven declares in a resonant voice, raising one arm to the sky.<NL>A wisp of pure qi seeps from its fingertip, swiftly vanishing into the Bead of Desire.<NL>In an instant, the bead overflows with clear light, and within it, the shadow of the Trinity - Heaven Incarnation appears...
f39c521b-d100-495e-bbb8-cef1c82e8d83/Eve.cn: “太吾得天道助，斩妖诛魔，无往不克！”<NL><NL>三才·天朗声说罢，单臂擎天，<NL>一缕清气自其指尖溢出，倏尔没入化念珠内，<NL>霎时间，珠身清光四溢，中更隐现三才·天化身之影……
f39c521b-d100-495e-bbb8-cef1c82e8d83/Eve.ru: "Тайу получает помощь Небес, убивая демонов и очищая зло, всегда побеждая!"<NL><NL>Троица - Небеса провозглашает звучным голосом, поднимая одну руку к небу.<NL>Струйка чистой Ци просачивается с кончика его пальца, быстро исчезая в Бусинке Желания.<NL>В одно мгновение бусина наполняется ясным светом, и внутри нее появляется тень Воплощения Троицы - Небес...

944b8a1d-fa22-4891-beea-1c260b8e8491/Eve.en: "To offer but a meager strength for all under heaven—I am truly fortunate..."<NL><NL>Trinity - Earth says softly, spreading both arms.<NL>A wisp of pure qi drifts from its abdomen, swiftly merging into the Bead of Desire.<NL>In an instant, the bead overflows with clear light, and within it, the shadow of Trinity - Earth Incarnation appears...
944b8a1d-fa22-4891-beea-1c260b8e8491/Eve.cn: “能为天下苍生略尽绵薄之力，吾甚幸也……”<NL><NL>三才·地柔声说罢，张开双臂，<NL>一缕清气自其腹中飘出，倏尔没入化念珠内，<NL>霎时间，珠身清光四溢，中更隐现三才·地化身之影……
944b8a1d-fa22-4891-beea-1c260b8e8491/Eve.ru: "Предложить лишь скудную Силу для всех под небесами — мне действительно повезло..."<NL><NL>- тихо говорит Тринити - Земля, разводя обеими руками.<NL>Струйка чистой Ци вырывается из его брюшной полости, быстро сливаясь с Бусинкой Желания.<NL>В одно мгновение бусина наполняется ясным светом, и внутри нее появляется тень Воплощения Троицы на Земле...

1c1c3f81-ec64-484e-83da-de8d7a5b770d/Eve.en: "With united hearts, the world will be saved..."<NL><NL>Trinity - Human says softly, a faint smile on its face.<NL>A wisp of pure qi flows from its eyes, swiftly merging into the Bead of Desire.<NL>In an instant, the bead overflows with clear light, and within it, the shadow of Trinity - Human Incarnation appears...
1c1c3f81-ec64-484e-83da-de8d7a5b770d/Eve.cn: “勠力同心，共挽苍生……”<NL><NL>三才·人轻声说罢，微微一笑，<NL>一缕清气自其双目溢出，倏尔没入化念珠内，<NL>霎时间，珠身清光四溢，中更隐现三才·人化身之影……
1c1c3f81-ec64-484e-83da-de8d7a5b770d/Eve.ru: "Объединив сердца, мир будет спасен..."<NL><NL>- тихо говорит Тринити - Человек со слабой улыбкой на лице.<NL>Струйка чистой Ци вытекает из его глаз, быстро сливаясь в Бусинку Желания.<NL>В одно мгновение бусина наполняется ясным светом, и внутри нее появляется тень Воплощения Троицы - Человека...

You think you're worthy of commanding the forebearer of all things?<NL>Heh... Taiwu child, to defy nature rules is but to seek your own destruction!"<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(After successfully banishing <Character key=Enemy str=Name/>'s embodiment, you can go to Yuanshan Prison to re-summon an embodiment...)</color>
692bc9f2-2a9e-41d8-aa5a-2d1a266b99d8/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正欲驱逐<Character key=Enemy str=Name/>化身，忽闻铁索震颤，<NL>但见此间幽幽天地，霎时黑气冥冥，魔音阗阗，<NL>而滔天黑气之中，一道狰狞魔影，骤然向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>袭来！<NL><NL>“区区凡俗，也配驱策万物之祖？<NL>呵呵呵……太吾小儿逆天而行，实乃自取灭亡！”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（成功驱逐<Character key=Enemy str=Name/>化身后，可前往元山石牢重新凝聚化身……）</color>

f16c0ba3-3822-4171-865e-e5616353ac02/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> finally defeats the embodiment of <Character key=Enemy str=Name/>.<NL>The demonic shadow instantly transforms into a billowing dark aura, dissolving into heaven and earth.<NL>Only the faint clanking of broken chains lingered in the air, echoing endlessly...<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(After successfully banishing <Character key=Enemy str=Name/>'s embodiment, you can go to Yuanshan Prison to re-summon an embodiment...)</color>
f16c0ba3-3822-4171-865e-e5616353ac02/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>终是战胜<Character key=Enemy str=Name/>化身，<NL>但见那道魔影忽地化作漫天黑气，消散于此间天地，<NL>余下铁索残鸣，悠悠不绝……<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（成功驱逐<Character key=Enemy str=Name/>化身，可前往元山石牢重新凝聚化身……）</color>

ef71fe2e-8b4e-46eb-a02a-698d4adccc83/Eve.en: Spirit drifting freely, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> glides for what feels like an eternity<NL>until reaching the chamber deep within the stone cell—the place where the Three Demons are sealed.<NL>Inside the cavern, three massive stone pillars burst from the ground and pierce the ceiling.<NL>Each pillar coils with several thick, black iron chains carved with talismanic runes;<NL>around them shimmer three ancient swords and treasured blades, their glow rippling like light through a vast heavenly net that binds the Cosmic Trinity below...<NL><NL><NL>"Taiwu vanquishes demons and does justice; it's the most righteous thing there is!"<NL>"Freeing even one soul from corruption? That joy is truly boundless."<NL>"We're fine here... but we do wonder, why's Successor of Taiwu here today?"
ef71fe2e-8b4e-46eb-a02a-698d4adccc83/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>任由神魂飘荡前行，<NL>不知过了多久，终于行至石牢深处，镇压三才的洞窟之前。<NL>但见洞窟之内之中三根粗大石柱破地而出，直插洞顶，每根石柱之上，<NL>皆缠有数条碗口粗细、刻满符文的乌黑铁链，更有三柄古剑宝刀，<NL>光华流转，自上而下，如天网一般笼罩着三才……<NL><NL><NL>“太吾斩妖诛魔，替天行道，正是再好不过！”<NL>“于此间渡得一人，化去一分邪念……吾便生无量欢喜……”<NL>“吾等一切皆好，却不知太吾传人此番前来，所为何事……”
